in_arabic.name: أحمدية
in_arabic.meaning: من أسماء الله الحسنى، المديح الكثير، الشكر الجزيل

in_urdu.name: احمدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک، بہت زیادہ تعریف، جزیل شکر
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام 'احمد' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بہت زیادہ تعریف یا جزیل شکر، اور یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات میں سے ایک ہے، اسلامی تقویم میں اس نام کی اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: अहमदिया
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक, बहुत अधिक प्रशंसा, अत्यधिक आभार
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम 'अहमद' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है बहुत अधिक प्रशंसा या अत्यधिक आभार, और यह अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक है, इस्लामी परंपरा में इस नाम का महत्व है

in_pashto.name: احمديہ
in_pashto.meaning: د الله ښوونکو نومونو څخه يو، ډېره ستايه، ډېر شکر
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم 'احمد' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې معنی یې ډېره ستايه یا ډېر شکر دی، او دا د الله تعالی صفاتو څخه يو دی، په اسلامي تړاد کې دا نوم مهم دی

in_english.name: Ahmadiyah
in_english.meaning: One of God's beautiful names, much praise, great gratitude
in_english.long_meaning: This name is derived from 'Ahmad' which means much praise or great gratitude, and it is one of God's attributes, significant in Islamic tradition, reflecting a quality of divine commendation and appreciation

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic religious community known as Ahmadiyya was founded in the late 19th century in India by Mirza Ghulam Ahmad. It is a reformist movement within Islam, emphasizing the prophethood and messianic claims of Mirza Ghulam Ahmad. This name, Ahmadiyya, carries a distinct cultural identity and separates its followers from other Islamic groups.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ahmad is considered to be a direct reference to the declaration made by Prophet Muhammad, Peace Be Upon Him, that before the Day of Judgment, God would raise up a man by the name of Ahmad. This prophecy is central to the belief system of the Ahmadi community, and their name serves as a constant reminder of their deep connection to the Prophet Muhammad and their belief in the prophethood of Mirza Ghulam Ahmad.
